left.raw_text: Patients will only be included in the study if they meet all of the following criteria:

right.raw_text: - Patient who has given informed consent
- Patient with age 18 years or older

left.raw_text: with at least 1 lesion of at least 12 mm maximal diameter. For lymph node metastases,

right.raw_text: the largest diameter should be at least 15 mm and the short axis at least 12 mm.
